title: Create aerostuff fix
description: The mod fixes a critical error between the Sable mod and Create Stuff 'N Additions, with a hook.
body:
This mod fixes a critical error in the Create Stuff 'N Additions mod when a player attempts to hook a physics object in the Create Aeronautics/Sable mod.
Now, when a player attempts to hook a physics object, it will simply fly through it.
